name: Standing Street Vendor Advisory Committee Regular Agenda 12122022
agenda_text:
CITY OF EL MONTE
  REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
  STANDING STREET VENDOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  Monday, December 12, 2022 - 9:00 a.m.
  El Monte City Hall East
  City Council Chambers
  11333 Valley Boulevard
  El Monte, California

1.  CALL TO ORDER / FLAG SALUTE

2.  ROLL CALL

3.  APPROVAL OF AGENDA

4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES
  None.

5.  PUBLIC COMMENT (NON-AGENDIZED ITEMS)

  Members of the public may comment upon items not appearing on the agenda,
  provided such comments are within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Committee.
  Speakers will be given 2 minutes to speak per person. The Committee may not
  deliberate or act upon matters not appearing on the agenda but may direct staff to
  place the matter on a future Committee agenda.

6.  COMMITTEE BUSINESS AND DISCUSSION ITEMS
  Members of the public will be afforded an opportunity to comment and ask
  questions on each of the agenda items below but shall be limited to 2 minutes
  per person.
  A) Update on Code Enforcement efforts with LA County Public Health
  B) Health and safety impacts on public right-of-way, storm drains, etc.
  C) Staff presentation and Committee direction on enforcement actions

7.  COMMITTEE COMMUNICATIONS

8.  ADJOURN MEETING

  Agenda Posted on December 8, 2022 at 4:10 p.m.
